params.body:
Closes #84

## Why

Reports could edit a row but not add one: the year came from a seeder, and the empty state still pointed at a script that is gone. A report nobody had planned (Growing Up in Public) had no row, so its sources could not be held and its file could not be uploaded.

## What changes

Under the year: **Add a report**, a title and a code, and "Add to the year".

- The address comes from the title (`Growing Up in Public` gives `growing-up-in-public`), accents folded.
- The report goes last in the year, says "coming soon", and its row opens at once so the sources can be added.
- A title already in the year is refused, with the reason.
- The line under it says that the report shows on gentells.com at once, and at which address.

No server change: `POST /reports` already creates a row for a new slug.

## Checked

- `src/report-slug.test.js`: 3 tests. Suite 81 of 81, build clean.
- Driven in a headless browser against mocked answers: a title that exists is refused; a new one posts `{slug, title, code, status: "coming soon", position}` and its row opens on the source list. No page errors.
params.title: Reports: add a report to the year from the Studio
